messages:
maria.g: Paging — Sentry ingest showing high error rate and missing exceptions in our 'errors-prod' dashboards. Getting multiple customer reports of no recent exceptions for the last ~30m. Not sure on scope yet.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: external:sentry.ingest.errors > 5m — rate 82% errors (svc: observability-ingest). Pager: oncall-pager.
oncall-pager: paging alex.r (on-call).
alex.r: Ack. Joining. Any local deploys in last hour?
maria.g: No deploys on our side, nothing from release channel. Sentry status page shows partial degradation but sparse details: https://status.sentry.io/incident/xyz — says API issues in region.
sam.t: I'm tailing our outgoing event delivery logs. We're seeing repeated 502/503 responses from Sentry's ingest API around 2025-11-07T12:15Z onwards. Example: `curl -i -X POST https://sentry.io/api/0/projects/org/proj/store/ -H 'X-Sentry-Auth: ...'` returns 503.
alex.r: Can you paste a small sample of the failed response?
sam.t: Sure: ```HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2025 12:18:02 GMT
Content-Type: application/json

{"detail":"Service temporarily unavailable"}```
katie.s: Customer-reported impact: three enterprise customers reported missing exception spikes in their dashboards and slower triage on support tickets. No full outage reported — primarily delayed ingestion and missing signals for some transactions.
alex.r: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Switch to our buffered fallback queue (events will be stored and retried to Sentry when healthy) — already enabled but verify backlog. 2) Enable our local error snapshot dump (write a copy of events to internal blob storage for later replay). 3) Notify customers and open incident status page entry.
maria.g: Buffering was toggled on auto, but retries still get 503s. Sam, can you check the size of the pending queue and estimated drain time once Sentry recovers?
sam.t: Queue backlog: ~42k events across producers, growth rate down from 600/s to 120/s (we throttled). Estimated drain ~45m once Sentry fully returns (best-effort). If Sentry is degraded for >30m, we should start replay from internal storage to avoid infinite queue growth.
alex.r: I'll open a ticket with Sentry support and escalate to their engineer on duty. Jordan, can you take over coordination if I'm paged elsewhere?
jordan.p: I can take over. Alex, leave handoff note when you switch.
alex.r: Created support ticket with Sentry — ticket #SNT-92421. Included logs and curl output. Also added them to the incident channel. Sent escalation via support portal.
sentry-bot: Incoming update from Sentry: "Investigating increased error rates in US-EAST region. Some events may be delayed or dropped. We'll update in 30 minutes."
katie.s: I'm drafting a short customer status blurb: "We are seeing delayed error ingestion caused by upstream Sentry API issues affecting exception visibility. No code changes required on your side; we're buffering and will replay events once Sentry is healthy. We'll update in 30 minutes." Thoughts?
alex.r: Looks good. Add note about timeline and ticket number. Also include potential workaround: temporarily switch critical apps to our internal alerting via direct logs if they need urgent triage.
maria.g: Quick check: our internal alerting (log-based) is working. Let's message the 3 affected customers directly with the blurb and offer to run a manual export of recent logs for urgent investigation.
jordan.p: Oncall handoff: Alex — I'm taking lead at 12:45Z. Please post a brief state summary and active actions. I'll keep the channel updated and follow Sentry updates.
alex.r: Handoff: status=degraded, cause=external Sentry ingest errors (503), mitigation=buffering enabled + internal blob snapshots enabled, support_ticket=SNT-92421, backlog=42k, estimated_drain=~45m once Sentry recovers. Next steps: monitor Sentry status, coordinate customer comms, be ready to trigger replay when Sentry healthy.
jordan.p: Ack. Also set runbook step: if Sentry doesn't recover by 13:30Z, run replay from blob store and notify customers of expected duplication risk.
sam.t: Adding note — when we replay, include event dedupe keys to reduce duplicate noise in Sentry downstream.
incident-bot: Update: ticket SNT-92421 status changed to "Investigating". Sentry update expected 12:50Z.
sentry-bot: Sentry status: "Partial degradation affecting event ingestion in US-EAST. No ETA yet."
katie.s: Customer comms sent to affected customers, offered manual log export; two accepted, one declined. Support cases updated with ticket link.
jordan.p: Monitoring: setting a watch on our dashboards for a restored success rate >98% for 5m window before initiating replay. Also enabling higher log retention for the next 24h.
maria.g: Any sign of auth failures or token expiry? Sentry's error is upstream; our auth tokens to Sentry are valid — we rotated keys 2 days ago. No expiry messages.
sam.t: Confirmed: Auth responses are 200 for token introspect; errors are 502/503 from ingest path, not auth.
alex.r: If Sentry issues persist >90m and their support can't commit to timeline, we should consider short-term migration of critical alerts to our own alerting backend until they restore service. Not ideal but reduces customer impact.
jordan.p: Noted. I'll keep that as a contingency. For now monitoring + replay plan stands.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: external_dependency:sentry | impact: partial | action: buffering/replay planned | owner: jordan.p
maria.g: Thanks everyone. Jordan, keep this thread as the single source of truth for the handoff. I'll jump back if anything new from infra.
jordan.p: Will do. Marking the incident as active. Next update at 12:55Z or sooner if Sentry posts an update. :hourglass_flowing_sand:"
